name: topic slot update
args: slot, key, itemIconId, pointValue, selectedFlag, disabledFlag
effect: Populates one of twelve grid tiles and increments visible topic count.
evidence: Ask/NegotiationWidget.updateAskParameter branch for low slot ids; local command stub comment.

name: operation result/history
args: selection, opponentOrPlayerFlag, iconId, value, isEnemy, showHistory
effect: Displays a selected operation, plays player/enemy operation SFX, and can write a history icon.

name: negotiation gauge
effect: Sets the negotiation progress gauge maximum and current value.

name: achievement gauge
effect: Sets the achievement/result progress gauge maximum and current value.

name: additional item 1
effect: Toggles first additional reward/item indicator and can play add-item SFX.

name: additional item 2
effect: Toggles second additional reward/item indicator and can play add-item SFX.

name: additional item 3
effect: Toggles third additional reward/item indicator and can play add-item SFX.

name: selected/history icon
effect: Writes one of the six last-selected item icons.
evidence: Local stub and update branch indexing selected icons.

name: ability availability
effect: Updates which ability buttons are usable in the child ability list.

name: phase/result visibility
effect: Toggles a result/phase visibility group; exact meaning still needs a runtime probe.
evidence: Recovered branch exists but local comment left blank.

name: time-up SFX
effect: Plays time-up sound and closes ability selector if it is open.

name: move or merge topic tile
effect: Moves/merges a topic from one grid tile to another, hides old slot, and updates count.

name: double or halve values
effect: Doubles or halves topic point values based on the supplied flag.
